fullData.title: The Lost Puppy Adventure
fullData.writingPrompt: Write a story about a brave lost puppy who goes on an unexpected journey to find its way back home, learning an important lesson along the way.

elements.label: Character
elements.prompt: Who is the main puppy character, and what is one special thing about them?

elements.label: Setting
elements.prompt: Where does the story take place? Use descriptive details about the sights, sounds, and smells of this place.

elements.label: Problem
elements.prompt: What happens that causes the puppy to get lost?

elements.label: Theme
elements.prompt: What lesson or idea will your story leave the reader with, and how will the events show it?

elements.label: Solution
elements.prompt: How does the puppy solve the problem and reach the end of the journey?

fullData.dialoguePrompt: Plan one important conversation between your puppy and another character that helps move the story forward or reveals the main theme.
